articles.title: Saurav Das moves Delhi High Court after government bars him from flying abroad
articles.summary: Saurav Das, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), has filed a petition in the Delhi High Court. He is challenging the government authorities' decision to restrict his international travel. This legal move underscores an individual's right to freedom of movement and access to justice against state actions, a significant matter for national legal discourse and civil liberties.

articles.title: Political tensions, AI-powered attacks to dominate APAC cyber threat landscape in 2027: Kaspersky
articles.summary: The Asia-Pacific's cybersecurity landscape faces significant challenges due to escalating geopolitical rivalries and regional conflicts. Further compounding this, cybercriminals are increasingly leveraging Artificial Intelligence, posing sophisticated threats. These interconnected factors are expected to profoundly reshape future cybersecurity strategies and resilience across the APAC region, demanding enhanced vigilance and collaborative defensive measures.

articles.title: An axis of resilience for the Himalaya: Why India, Nepal and China must watch the mountains together
articles.summary: India has proven to be Nepal's key first responder and recovery partner. However, the more significant challenge is preparing the Himalayan region for future floods. This crucial task requires comprehensive regional cooperation, specifically involving China, to develop effective disaster preparedness and mitigation strategies across shared borders. Such collaborative efforts are vital for ensuring long-term environmental security and humanitarian resilience in the vulnerable Himalayan ecosystem.

articles.title: Phone spying to missiles: Why India-Israel strategic ties go beyond Modi
articles.summary: India's opposition, the Indian National Congress, has criticized Prime Minister Modi's government for three years over its refusal to condemn an international entity (likely Israel). This persistent domestic debate underscores crucial aspects of India's foreign policy and global alignment, vital knowledge for an SSB aspirant understanding national strategy.

articles.title: UK warns companies of potential Russian sabotage threat
articles.summary: Britain's Defence Ministry and MI5 have warned companies supporting Ukraine's military about potential sabotage attempts from Russia. This advisory highlights escalating geopolitical tensions and the risk of hybrid warfare tactics. Businesses involved in providing aid are urged to enhance their security protocols against cyber and physical threats to mitigate the risks posed by their involvement in the conflict.

articles.title: Hyderabad man, 23, leaves Rs 50 lakh Goldman Sachs job, takes 50% pay cut to build India's defence technology; why young professionals are choosing 'purpose' over pay
articles.summary: Apollyon Dynamics, a prominent defence-tech startup, originated from a hostel dormitory at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad. This indigenous venture has made significant strides since its modest beginnings, garnering attention for its contributions to the defence sector. Its journey highlights successful innovation and entrepreneurship within India's strategic technology landscape, showcasing the potential for young talent in national security.
